description:
Daydream is a fun and easy way to explore cities around the world. Search for a city to explore, use the shuffle feature to let the app pick one for you, or explore based on your current location! Browse top sights to see and top places to eat for each city. View a specific top sight on a map, read reviews, and explore nearby locations just by tapping. Save cities to your Wishlist so you can keep track of where you want to go. Browse your saved destinations by country or filter them by continent. City summaries powered by Apple Intelligence help you get to know each destination. Get lost exploring your next destination!

Use Daydream to:

- Save cities from discovery or city details with the heart button
- Organize your Wishlist by country and filter saved cities by continent
- Explore cities through search or the shuffle button using Google Places APIs
- Scroll through beautiful pictures of top sights and top eateries for each city
- Read reviews for specific points of interest and tap to redirect to the reviewer's page on Google Maps
- Interact with the map by tapping on points of interest to read reviews and get contact/address information
- Toggle the map style using the night mode button for more comfortable viewing at night

I hope you enjoy the app and find a new destination to explore!
keywords: city, discover, travel, tourist, tourism, top sights, top eateries, points of interest, map,wishlist
whatsNew:
Keep your next destinations in one place with the new Wishlist.

- Save cities from the discovery screen or city details with a tap of the heart.
- Browse saved cities grouped alphabetically by country, complete with country flags.
- Filter your wishlist by continent with compact glass buttons that wrap to fit your screen.
- Open saved cities to explore their sights and eateries, or swipe to remove them.
- Enjoy larger city titles and hearts on wider iPhone and iPad layouts.

Your wishlist stays on this device between launches.
